---
title: "Melbourne Housing Data Exploration"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)

melb <- read_csv("melb_data.csv")
```

## Looking at the Data

```{r}
glimpse(melb)
```

## Categorical Variable Summaries

```{r}
table(melb$Type)
```

```{r}
table(melb$Type, melb$Regionname)
```

## Numerical Summaries

```{r}
melb |>
  group_by(Type) |>
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(Price, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
```{r}
melb |>
  group_by(Regionname) |>
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_distance = mean(Distance, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
## Graphical Summaries

```{r}
ggplot(melb, aes(x = Price)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Melbourne Housing Prices",
    x = "Price",
    y = "Number of Properties"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(melb, aes(x = Type, y = Price, fill = Type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Housing Prices by Property Type",
    x = "Property Type",
    y = "Price",
    fill = "Property Type"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(melb, aes(x = Distance, y = Price, color = Type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Housing Price vs. Distance from Melbourne CBD",
    x = "Distance from CBD (km)",
    y = "Price",
    color = "Property Type"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(melb, aes(x = Regionname, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Property Types by Region",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Number of Properties",
    fill = "Property Type"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
ggplot(melb, aes(x = Price, fill = Type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ Regionname) +
  labs(
    title = "Housing Price Distributions by Region",
    x = "Price",
    y = "Number of Properties",
    fill = "Property Type"
  )
```

```{r}
melb |>
  filter(!is.na(Regionname)) |>
  group_by(Regionname, Type) |>
  summarize(
    mean_price = mean(Price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Type, y = Regionname, fill = mean_price)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Housing Price by Region and Property Type",
    x = "Property Type",
    y = "Region",
    fill = "Average Price"
  )
```
